Performance.axisQuestionConsistency: How consistently did I show up to my sessions, relative to what I intended?
Performance.axisQuestionEffort: How much of my capacity did I genuinely invest during sessions?
Performance.axisQuestionFocus: How mentally present and attentive was I during sessions?
Performance.axisQuestionRecharge: How well did I recharge between sessions — sleep, rest, and taking care of my body?
Performance.axisQuestionSenseOfProgress: When I look back at this period, does my practice feel like it moved me forward in a way that mattered to me?
Performance.profileBurnoutRiskMessage: You're showing up consistently, but effort, focus and sense of progress are all low. Recovery may need attention before pushing harder.
Performance.profileOverreachingMessage: Effort is high but recharge is low. Build in more rest to sustain this pace.
Performance.profileStuckMessage: Consistency and effort are strong, but progress doesn't feel like it's landing. Worth raising with your coach.
Performance.profileCoastingMessage: Consistency and effort are strong, but focus could lift the quality of your sessions.
Performance.profileInconsistentMessage: Showing up is the main thing holding you back — the rest is solid once you're there.
Performance.profileBalancedMessage: Every area is strong. Keep it up.
